findings.title: Committed raw evidence is large and only now budget-guarded
evidence: inventory: evidence/ = 958 files of 1,410 tracked files (68%)
README.md Quick start documents the budget and archive policy
findings.impact: Unbounded evidence growth bloats clone/CI; the budget now bounds it but a plan has not yet been exercised against the 2,500-file ceiling.
findings.recommendation: Keep the size gate in ci/validate.sh; rehearse the archive-and-sidecar flow before the cap trips.

findings.title: Pack inventory tooling now emits routes/schema/entrypoints
evidence: tools/repo_inventory.py output includes routes[], schema_tables[], entry_points[], workflows[]
inventory.json: 3 routes, 17 schema tables, 36 entry points, 5 workflows
findings.impact: Previously the Wave-0 inventory was blind to the route table, schema and entry points; that gap is closed.
findings.recommendation: None; keep the extractors covered by the pack self-test.

findings.title: Generated models/schemas/dashboard JSON committed and can drift
evidence: api/generate_models.py --check and api/generate_schemas.py --check run in ci/validate.sh
findings.impact: A stale generated artifact could ship if CI is bypassed (branch protection is plan-gated).
findings.recommendation: Keep the generated-artifact checks in the advisory validate workflow and re-run before release.

report:
- Read-only analysis of `MaineCyberTech/falcon-edge` at `ba4becb` (git `ba4becb6ecd8fdc0c4e0363a67d7a62f60985788`, branch `main`).
- Deterministic lens (LLM-free) run on the lab (`ci-runner`, HTTP job API) and locally: LICENSE absent; no non-executable tracked `*.sh`; no CRLF tracked text; no tracked secret-like filenames; `.gitattributes` present.
- Wave-0 inventory via `tools/repo_inventory.py` (1,410 files; 5 workflows; 3 routes; 17 schema tables; 56 test files).
- Target repository is not applicable to this domain; the finding records the evidence and the future-readiness trigger.
- No secrets printed; all evidence is file:line references.
